units: metres; glTF Y-up; colours are in COLOR_0 (linear), no textures
shader: PROP_VERT / PROP_FRAG in src/shaders.js (vertex colour + shared lighting + light dust film). Use double-sided when a copy is mirrored.

sample_scoop.origin: centre of the grip; handle along +Y (tether ring end at +Y, scoop pan at -Y)
sample_scoop.how_to_hold: child of the RIGHT first-person arm group (arm space of arms.json): position [0,-0.045,-0.47], basis X=[0,-1,0] Y=[1,0,0] Z=[0,0,1]; arm finger pose 'fist'
sample_scoop.note: generic EVA soil scoop with a glove-sized grip and tether ring, made for Marswalk; not a copy of a specific flight tool

contents.ScoopSoil: heap of loose soil in the pan (1.0k triangles)
contents.ScoopRocks: seven rock chips in the pan (560 triangles)
contents.how: extra meshes inside sample_scoop.glb, already in place in the pan; hide both, show one after a sampling clip, hide it again during stow_sample or pour_sample (times in arms.json)
contents.look: no textures; vertex alpha tells PROP_FRAG what the surface is: 1 = hardware, 0.5 = rock (mottling, pale veins, dark specks), 0 = soil (grains and clods)

tool_case.origin: centre of the carry handle; body hangs below; long side along X
tool_case.how_to_carry: each frame: position = world position of the astronaut bone 'hand.L' minus 0.10 m in Y; rotation.y = astronaut heading + 90 deg (long side along the walking direction)
tool_case.note: generic hard sample/tool case with latches, hinges, corner bumpers and a label plate
tool_case.parts: two meshes: ToolCase (body with an open cavity) and its child ToolCaseLid (lid with the handle; origin on the hinge line)
tool_case.hand_over: 1) partner plays case_set_down, release the case at 0.9 s and open the lid; 2) player stands 0.85 m from the case on the side away from the partner and plays pour_sample; 3) close the lid, partner plays case_set_down again and grabs the case at 0.9 s. Reference: partner.toggleCase, props.update and the 'pourbtn' handler in src/main.js
